messages:
alex: CI failing for Go SDK release. Works locally but CI can't resolve module. Error: module declares path .../v2 but was required as .../go-sdk.
support-bot: Incident INC-2026-0421 created and assigned to @marta.
marta: can you paste the go.mod and the exact CI error? also what go versions locally vs CI?
alex: local go1.20, CI uses go1.21. go.mod (root):
```
module github.com/redwoodinc/go-sdk

go 1.20

require (
	github.com/some/dep v1.3.0
)

replace github.com/redwoodinc/go-sdk => ../
```
CI error: 
```
go: github.com/redwoodinc/go-sdk@v0.0.0-20260323120000-abcdef123456: parsing go.mod:
	module declares its path as: github.com/redwoodinc/go-sdk/v2
	but was required as: github.com/redwoodinc/go-sdk
```
alex: I tagged v2.0.0 but forgot to update module path, thought replace would cover it.
samir: that's the common major-version mismatch. If you tag v2.x, the module path must end in /v2. replace is local-only; CI and proxies won't use your local replace.
ingrid: also check GOPRIVATE/GONOSUMDB in CI. Private modules can cause proxy/sumdb rejections. Run: `GO111MODULE=on go list -m -json all` and `go list -m -versions github.com/redwoodinc/go-sdk`.
marta: repro steps for us: 1) checkout commit, 2) run `go build ./...` with go1.21 in clean env (no replace), 3) `GOPRIVATE=github.com/redwoodinc GOPROXY=direct go get github.com/redwoodinc/go-sdk@v2.0.0`
samir: quick fixes:
- Option A (recommended): update module path to `module github.com/redwoodinc/go-sdk/v2`, bump go.mod and push annotated tag `v2.0.0`.
- Option B: don't use a v2 tag if you want to keep module path unchanged.
- Ensure CI sets `GOPRIVATE=github.com/redwoodinc` and `GONOSUMDB` where needed. Also verify CI clones tags (avoid shallow clones without tags).
alex: do tags need to be annotated? I used lightweight tag earlier.
samir: annotated tags are safer for version metadata; some tools/proxies rely on them. Also confirm the git server exposes tags to CI (shallow clones can miss tags).
ingrid: example CI env we use for internal modules:
```
export GOPRIVATE=github.com/redwoodinc
export GOPROXY=https://proxy.golang.org,direct
export GOSUMDB=off
```
marta: action items for @alex: update module path to include /v2, push commit, create annotated tag `git tag -a v2.0.0 -m "v2 release"` and push tags, set CI env to go1.21 with GOPRIVATE. We'll re-run CI.
alex: updated repo: module now `github.com/redwoodinc/go-sdk/v2`, pushed annotated v2.0.0 tag, retriggered CI.
ci-bot: build 7891 (go-sdk/v2) started on main.
ci-bot: build 7891 succeeded.
alex: build passed, downloads now show `found github.com/redwoodinc/go-sdk/v2 v2.0.0` and it downloads fine. thanks! :tada:
marta: closing INC-2026-0421, adding KB: "Go major version mismatch + CI env misconfigured caused module resolution failure." PR with CI env recommendations: https://git.company/infra/ci-config/pulls/45
samir: add repo CONTRIBUTING note: when bumping major version update module path, use annotated tags, validate in ephemeral CI without local replace.
alex: will add to CONTRIBUTING.md. thanks everyone!
